Welcome to
St Edward’s Catholic Primary School
Important Notices
Reception 2027 open day on Wednesday 14th October at 2pm
Reception 2027 open day on Wednesday 14th October at 2pm
Hello & Welcome
We are a two form entry Voluntary Aided Catholic Academy school for children aged 2 to 11, situated on Green Street in the diverse community of East London. St Edward’s was also designated as a National Teaching School in March 2013, which has now developed into a teacher training partnership.
We have widened our school and faith family by teaming up with primary schools across Newham as we join the Our Lady of Grace Multi-Academy Trust (MAT.) This means we are now working closely with our friends in St Helen’s, St Joachim’s, St Francis, St Antony's, St Winefride's and St Michael's.
We hope our website gives you an opportunity to share some of the things that make St Edward’s special as well as finding out more about what we do.
Paul Underwood Headteacher

British Values
The government has set out its definition of British Values as:
At St Edward’s we actively promote values, virtues and ethics that shape our pupils' character and moral perspective, through the teachings of the Church. We are confident that our continued focus on the Gospel Values will give our pupils the necessary awareness of what it means to be a good citizen and ensures that the children are ready for life in 21st Century Britain.
Through our curriculum of RSHE, PSHCE/Well-being, RE, History and Geography, as well as the general school aims, mission and ethos we are able to make real links between the values of our pupils and the lives of others in their community, country and the world in general. We teach about democracy, civic responsibility, rules and laws, the monarchy, equality, values and virtues, environmental awareness and understanding of other faiths.
